reviewer.task: Independent source-first audit of all six frozen-baseline ASCII parses

methodology: Read every original ASCII file before comparing results. Did not read tree_parser.py, tree_parser_snapshot.py, earlier-round results, or parser tests, and did not invoke any parser.

Manually established each tree/prose boundary, root, four-column branch convention, and the 14 routed-wire label overrides directly from source. The independent checker uses only those observed source-specific conventions.

Compared all 716 parsed nodes: labels, source line and end line, raw source span, label and branch columns, depth, parent, ordered children, and roots. The seven ambiguous appendix nodes were separately verified against the bullet-tree alternative.

Checked every actual containment edge (704), root (12), and all 797 original lines for exact raw content, numbering, classification, and node references. Checked node order and parent/child reciprocity. Cross-checked every review-table node against the JSON output.

Preserve both raw-label and clean-semantic-label rubrics; ordinary prose-bullet ambiguity is independent. Exception and strict diagnostic outcomes are recorded separately and do not determine semantic correctness.

rubric.primary: Clean semantic labels and faithfully reconstructed ASCII containment forests, excluding unambiguously detached prose; genuinely ambiguous appendix membership remains ambiguous.
rubric.wire_labels: Do not absorb visibly routed right-side wires into semantic entity labels. Keep textual inline reference arrows with named targets as label annotations. Non-containment graph links are documented but not required as tree edges.
rubric.literal_alternative: If labels are defined as the complete raw suffix following a branch marker, routed wires are literal label content rather than parse errors.
